---
name: New experiment
about: Propose an experiment
title: "Experiment: "
labels: experiment
---

Answer what you can. Blanks are fine — a sharp question with an empty design is
more useful than a full design for a vague one. Delete anything that doesn't
apply rather than filling it in with hedging.

## Question

What specifically is being asked?

## Where it came from

What system did something you couldn't explain? Real behaviour beats a
hypothetical.

## What would change your mind

What result would tell you the hypothesis is wrong? If nothing would, this isn't
an experiment yet.

## Rough design

Conditions, task, what varies between them.

## What's load-bearing

The one thing that, removed, should make the effect disappear.

## Confounders you already see

The ones you'd have to rule out. Naming them here is not an admission that the
idea is weak — it's the main evidence that it's been thought about.

## Would this open to participation?

Would outside players produce data you can't get alone? Note that a game here
needs deterministic judging — see [games/](../../games/README.md).
